hero_subtitle: Explore how Staffordshire County Council manages public money. Budget analysis powered by GOV.UK MHCLG data.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £4.23B across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £4.20B. Non-procurement rows: settlement noise (£25.9M) — all excluded from third-party-supplier forensic analyses. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

settlement_noise.note: BACS / EFT settlement micro-journals. Not a supplier.

political_control.tenure_note: Reform UK majority since the 1 May 2025 all-out election (won 49 of 62 seats; 48 after a July-2025 Conservative by-election). Leadership has churned: first Leader Cllr Ian Cooper (May 2025) was expelled from Reform UK in December 2025; Cllr Martin Murray was elected Leader on 26 March 2026, with a ten-member all-Reform Cabinet. Same may_2025 cohort as Kent, LCC, Durham, Derbyshire, Worcestershire, Leicestershire and Lincolnshire (previously mis-tagged may_2026_new).
